events.title: 에버턴 sign 더비 카운티 defender Craig Short for £2.4 million.
코번트리 시티 sign winger John Salako from 크리스털 팰리스 for £1.5 million.
미들즈브러 prepare for their return to the Premier League by paying a club-record £5.25 million for 토트넘 홋스퍼 forward Nick Barmby .
Eric Cantona announces his intention to leave English football, but 맨체스터 유나이티드 refused to terminate his contract.
Cantona announces his intention to stay with 맨체스터 유나이티드 after a meeting with 알렉스 퍼거슨 in 파리 FC . 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 sign Reading goalkeeper Shaka Hislop for £1.575 million.

The Football League season begins. Relegated 크리스털 팰리스 begin their bid for an immediate return to the Premier League with a dramatic 4–3 home win over 반즐리 . Oldham , who went down a year earlier, start the season well with a 3–0 home win over newly promoted Huddersfield . 포츠머스 beat Southend 4–2 at Fratton Park .
A Vinny Samways goal gives 에버턴 a 1–0 win over 블랙번 로버스 in the FA Charity Shield . 노리치 시티 begin their quest for an immediate return to the Premier League by beating 루턴 타운 3–1 at Kenilworth Road .
Andrea Silenzi becomes first Italian to play for a Premier League side when he joins 노팅엄 포리스트 in a £1.8million move from 토리노 .
아약스 once again claims the Dutch Super Cup , the annual opening of the new season in the Eredivisie , this time by a 2–1 win in extra-time over 페예노르트 .

The FA Premier League season begins with 맨체스터 유나이티드 defeated 3–1 at 애스턴 빌라, which sparks immediate criticism throughout the media due to the number of young players in the team as well as the fact that United have sold three key players this summer and not made any major signings, Alan Hansen is known for coining the phrase "you can't win anything with kids". 블랙번 로버스 begin their defence of the Premier League title with a 1–0 win at home over 퀸스 파크 레인저스. Matt Le Tissier scores a hat-trick for 사우샘프턴 at The Dell but they lost 4–3 to 노팅엄 포리스트. 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 beat 코번트리 시티 3–0 at home, with record signing Les Ferdinand scoring on his debut. 볼턴 원더러스 lose 3–2 to 윔블던 at Selhurst Park in their first top flight game since May 1980.
미들즈브러's Nick Barmby scores on his debut, a 1–1 draw against 아스널 at Highbury .
맨체스터 유나이티드 bounce back from their opening day defeat with a 2–1 home win over 웨스트햄 유나이티드 .
에버턴 complete their club record £5 million signing of 맨체스터 유나이티드 winger Andrei Kanchelskis , more than a month after their offer for Kanchelskis was first accepted.

미들즈브러 defeat 첼시 2–0 in their first game at the new Riverside Stadium , with Craig Hignett scoring the stadium's first goal. 맨체스터 유나이티드 beat 윔블던 3–1 at Old Trafford . Leeds are top of the league for the first time since their 1992 title triumph after a 2–0 home win over 애스턴 빌라 .
뉴캐슬 유나이티드 go top of the Premier League with a 2–0 win at 셰필드 웬즈데이.
맨체스터 유나이티드 defeat 블랙번 로버스 2–1, despite being reduced to 10 men after Roy Keane was sent off for two bookable offences.
뉴캐슬 유나이티드 are the month-end leaders in the Premier League with a 1–0 home win over 미들즈브러, with second-placed Leeds being held to a 1–1 draw at 사우샘프턴.
